note: Single swappable nominal parameter set for Part A v2 general (PARTA_V2_GENERAL_DESIGN.md sections 2 and 7). Treiber textbook highway defaults, ONE set for ALL vehicles, no vType anywhere. param_set_id = sha256 of this file.
integrator: ballistic_new_speed (v' = max(0, v + a*dt); s' = s + v'*dt; the project's measured SUMO integrator form, p3lib)

mobil.note: OWNER FLAG (design deviation, 2026-09-30): cooldown_s (2.0), lc_min_speed_mps (1.0) and ego_gain_floor_mps2 were declared stability guards in the PA2G-A param set; they are NOT textbook IDM/MOBIL rules and are retired to 0 (OFF) in this nominal set per the owner's design-deviation rule. The PA2G-A churn was later traced to the swapped _neighbors leader/follower structure (engine.py), not to missing guards; the churn collapse needs no guard (test_engine_lc_regression pins no-ping-pong with cooldown 0). Textbook values (politeness_p, b_safe, threshold, keep-right bias) are unchanged.

merge.incentive_rule: MOBIL gain must exceed accel_threshold*(1-u); safety b_safe(u) = b_safe_base + (b_safe_end-b_safe_base)*u

vehicle.length_source: nominal unless the recon sample provides length_m

cav_execution.rule: kin_idm (measured SUMO execution rule, partA_act results/exec_rule_fit.json): v' = max(0, min(clip(T, v - b_kin*dt, v + a_kin*dt), v + idm_acc_nominal*dt))
cav_execution.note: kinematic clip bounds are the frozen CIRCLES adapter command bounds (partA_ctrl ACCEL_MIN/-3.0, ACCEL_MAX/1.5 mirrored positive); the IDM term uses this nominal set (no vType)

geometry.source: frozen WM-30 model-world geometry (p2C topology; test-anchored OFFSETS of p3lib)

rsu_zone_default.source: frozen recon_v6.rsu zone (MAIN_ZONE_D (0,800) on the two mainline lanes; all merge lanes 1487606179_{0,1,2}; the whole ramp 11553048#1_0; DOWN_ZONE_P (0,150) on the downstream lanes 1487606178_{0,1}), expressed per lane_phys in model-world s (half-open [min, max))

free_road_flag.rule_predictor: a tracked vehicle with no same-lane leader in the sample is flagged when the zone downstream boundary of its lane lies short of the lane end (the missing leader may lie beyond the zone)
free_road_flag.rule_eval_true_state: exact: the vehicle's true same-lane leader at t (anywhere on the modelled road) is not in the zone-restricted initial state
